name: Calibre-Web Automated
description: Calibre-Web Automated adds automatic book management and PDF/EPUB conversion on top of Calibre-Web, plus built-in KOReader Kosync at /kosync. Library metadata lives in media/data/calibre; book files live in media/data/books (separate book files mode).
short_desc: Calibre library management, conversion, and built-in KOReader sync.
author: https://github.com/janeczku/
